description.ncbi_summary: This gene encodes a member of the RIEG/PITX homeobox family, which is in the bicoid class of homeodomain proteins. Members of this family are involved in organ development and left-right asymmetry. This protein acts as a transcriptional regulator involved in basal and hormone-regulated activity of prolactin. [provided by RefSeq, Jul 2008].

uniprot_function.text: Sequence-specific DNA-binding transcriptional activator of the bicoid class that controls regional morphogenesis and organ-specific gene programs; binds bicoid/TAAT-type elements (consensus TAATCC) via its homeodomain, whose bicoid-class specificity determinant directs target selection, and acts combinatorially by directly contacting partner transcription factors (PubMed:18950742). Specifies hindlimb identity and drives hindlimb outgrowth through direct activation of the hindlimb enhancers of the T-box factor TBX4; ectopic expression in the forelimb induces TBX4, HOXC10 and HOXC11 and confers leg-like character (By similarity). Acts in early anterior pituitary development, activating downstream regulators such as LHX3, and transactivates pituitary hormone promoters (POMC, CGA, LHB, FSHB, TSHB, PRL) in synergy with POU1F1, NR5A1, EGR1 and TBX19, including direct enhancement of NR5A1 activity (By similarity). Plays also a critical role in the transcription of enzymes involved in adrenal steroidogenesis such as CYP11B1 (PubMed:12915995).
